en.t: Battle of Megiddo: The first battle to have been recorded in what is accepted as relatively reliable detail
en.s: The Battle of Megiddo (fought 15th century BC) was fought between Egyptian forces under the command of Pharaoh Thutmose III and a large rebellious coalition of Canaanite vassal states led by the king of Kadesh. It is the first battle to have been recorded in what is accepted as relatively reliable detail. Megiddo is also the first recorded use of the composite bow and the first body count.

zh.t: 米吉多战役：第一场有相对可靠详细记录的战役
zh.s: 米吉多战役（发生于公元前15世纪）是埃及军队与迦南附庸城邦组成的大型叛乱联盟之间的一场战斗。埃及军队由法老图特摩斯三世指挥，联盟由卡迭石国王率领。这是第一场留下相对可靠详细记录的战役。米吉多战役也是复合弓首次有文字记载的使用，以及首次有记载的伤亡人数统计。

en.t: Pope Leo II is elected head of the Catholic Church, although he will not be consecrated until 17 August
en.s: Pope Leo II (c. 01 January 611 – 28 June 683) was the Bishop of Rome from 17 August 682 to his death on 28 June 683. One of the popes of the Byzantine Papacy, he is described by a contemporary biographer as both just and learned. He is commemorated as a saint in the Roman Martyrology.

zh.s: 682年4月16日，利奥二世当选罗马教皇，但直到同年8月17日才开始担任罗马主教，683年6月28日去世。他约生于611年，是拜占庭教皇时期的教宗；同时代传记作者称他公正而博学，罗马殉道圣人录也将其列为圣人。

en.s: The Battle of Stracathro, also known as the Battle of Inchbare, took place on 16 April 1130 about 3 miles north of Brechin, Scotland, near the River North Esk. Óengus of Moray and Máel Coluim mac Alaxandair invaded Scotland with 5000 warriors according to the Anglo-Norman chronicler Orderic Vitalis. The forces loyal to David I of Scotland under Edward, Constable of Scotland met and defeated the invading army. Óengus of Moray was killed along with some 4000 of the Moravians.

zh.s: 斯特拉卡思罗之战又称因奇贝尔之战，于1130年4月16日在苏格兰布里金以北约3英里、北埃斯克河附近发生。据盎格鲁—诺曼编年史家奥德里克·维塔利斯记载，马里领主恩格斯与马尔科卢姆·麦克·阿拉克桑德尔率5000名战士入侵苏格兰。忠于苏格兰国王大卫一世的军队在苏格兰军事统领爱德华指挥下，迎击并打败入侵者。恩格斯与约4000名马里人战死。

en.t: Stefan Dušan, "the Mighty", is crowned Emperor of the Serbs at Skopje, his empire occupying much of the Balkans
en.s: Stefan Uroš IV Dušan (Serbian Cyrillic: Стефан Урош IV Душан), also known as Dušan the Mighty (Serbian Cyrillic: Душан Силни; c. 1308 – 20 December 1355), was the King of Serbia from 8 September 1331 and Emperor of the Serbs, Greeks, Bulgarians and Albanians from 16 April 1346 until his death in 1355. Dušan is considered one of the greatest medieval Balkan conquerors.

zh.t: 斯特凡·杜尚在斯科普里加冕为塞尔维亚皇帝，其帝国当时控制巴尔干大部
zh.s: 斯特凡·乌罗斯四世·杜尚（塞尔维亚语西里尔字母：Стефан Урош IV Душан），又称“强者杜尚”（塞尔维亚语西里尔字母：Душан Силни；约1308年—1355年12月20日），自1331年9月8日起担任塞尔维亚国王，并从1346年4月16日起担任塞尔维亚人、希腊人、保加利亚人和阿尔巴尼亚人的皇帝，直至1355年去世。杜尚被视为巴尔干中世纪最伟大的征服者之一。

en.s: The Battle of Portomaggiore took place near Portomaggiore in the province of Ferrara, Italy on 16 April 1395. It was fought between the Este troops of the Ferrara Regency Council fighting in the name of the young Niccolò III d'Este, Marquis of Ferrara and the rebel forces of his uncle, Azzo X d'Este, pretender to the Lordship of Ferrara.

zh.s: 波尔托马焦雷之战于1395年4月16日在意大利费拉拉省波尔托马焦雷附近发生。费拉拉摄政委员会以年轻的费拉拉侯爵尼科洛三世·德斯特之名，派出埃斯特家族军队，对抗其叔父、费拉拉领主争位者阿佐十世·德斯特的叛军。

en.s: The Revolt of the Comuneros (Spanish: Guerra de las Comunidades de Castilla, "War of the Communities of Castile") was an uprising by citizens of Castile against the rule of Charles I and his administration between 1520 and 1521. At its height, the rebels controlled the heart of Castile, ruling the cities of Valladolid, Tordesillas, and Toledo.
en.n: The Revolt of the Comuneros begins in Spain against the rule of Charles V.

zh.s: 社群起义（西班牙语：Guerra de las Comunidades de Castilla，即“卡斯蒂利亚社群战争”）是卡斯蒂利亚民众于1520至1521年反抗查理一世及其政府的起义。起义最盛时，叛军控制了卡斯蒂利亚腹地，并统治巴利亚多利德、托德西利亚斯和托莱多等城市。
zh.n: 西班牙爆发社群起义，反抗查理五世的统治。

en.s: The Battle of Jarte was fought from 4 to 16 April 1542 between the forces of Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi and the Ethiopian Empire assisted by a Portuguese expeditionary force led by Cristóvão da Gama. The Abyssinians and Portuguese were victorious, with Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi wounded by the outnumbered Christian force, and the Adalites forced to retreat.

zh.s: 哈尔特之战于1542年4月4日至16日爆发，交战双方是艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐的军队与埃塞俄比亚帝国军队，后者还得到克里斯托旺·达·伽马率领的葡萄牙远征军支援。阿比西尼亚和葡萄牙联军获胜，艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐被人数较少的基督教军队打伤，阿达尔军队被迫撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Vilnius was a battle which took place on 16 April 1702 in Vilnius, the capital of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, during the Great Northern War. After having seen the city early seized by the Swedish army, the grand notary of Lithuania, Ludwik Konstanty Pociej launched a surprise attack with 3,000 men (other figures states as few as 2,000 and others 4,000 men) on the equally matched Swedes of 3,000 men (due to intense sickness it could be lower [the Dala regiment alone had only 740 men prior to the battle in comparison to the 1,200 of the original strength] with as few as 2,500 men) under Carl Gustav Mörner stationed inside the city.

zh.s: 维尔纽斯之战于1702年4月16日在立陶宛大公国首都维尔纽斯发生，属于大北方战争。瑞典军队先前占领该城后，立陶宛大书记官路德维克·康斯坦蒂·波切伊率3000人突袭驻城瑞军；另有记载将其兵力列为低至2000人或高至4000人。卡尔·古斯塔夫·默纳指挥的瑞军名义上也有3000人，但因疾病严重，实际可能低至2500人。其中仅达拉团战前便只剩740人，原有编制为1200人。

en.s: The Battle of Slankamen was a naval engagement between the Ottoman fleet and the Austrians, who were returning from Pančevo, in the Danbue. The Ottomans won the battle and captured the Austrian commander.

zh.s: 斯兰卡门之战是奥斯曼舰队与奥地利舰队之间的一场海战。奥地利舰队当时正从潘切沃沿多瑙河返航。奥斯曼人获胜并俘获奥地利指挥官。

en.s: The Battle of Puerto Cabello was a failed attack on a Spanish colonial port during the War of Jenkins' Ear on 16 April 1743.

zh.s: 波多贝洛港之战是詹金斯耳朵战争期间对西班牙殖民港口的一次失败进攻，发生于1743年4月16日。

en.s: The Battle of Culloden (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Chùil Lodair) was the final confrontation of the Jacobite rising of 1745 and part of a religious civil war in Britain. On 16 April 1746, the Jacobite forces of Charles Edward Stuart were decisively defeated by loyalist troops commanded by William Augustus, Duke of Cumberland, near Inverness in the Scottish Highlands. Queen Anne died in 1714, with no living children; she was the last monarch of the House of Stuart. Under the terms of the Act of Settlement 1701, she was succeeded by her second cousin George I of the House of Hanover, who was a descendant of the Stuarts through his maternal grandmother, Elizabeth, a daughter of James VI and I.

zh.s: 卡洛登之战是1745年詹姆斯党起义的最后一战，也是英国一场宗教内战的一部分。1746年4月16日，查尔斯·爱德华·斯图亚特的詹姆斯党军，在苏格兰高地因弗内斯附近，被坎伯兰公爵威廉·奥古斯都指挥的王室忠诚派部队彻底击败。1714年，斯图亚特王朝最后一位君主安妮女王去世，没有在世子女。依据《1701年王位继承法》，由她的再从兄弟、汉诺威王朝的乔治一世继位。乔治通过外祖母伊丽莎白，也是斯图亚特家族的后裔；伊丽莎白是苏格兰詹姆斯六世、亦即英格兰詹姆斯一世的女儿。

en.s: The Action of 16 April 1755 was fought off Benidorm, between a Spanish fleet of 5 xebecs and an Algerian fleet of 3 xebecs. The Spaniards were victorious and captured the whole crew.

zh.s: 1755年4月16日，五艘西班牙谢贝克式帆船与三艘阿尔及利亚同型帆船，在贝尼多姆外海交战。西班牙一方获胜，并俘获敌方全部船员。

en.s: The Battle of Porto Praya was fought on 16 April 1781 during the American Revolutionary War between a Royal Navy fleet under Commodore George Johnstone and a French Navy squadron under Pierre André de Suffren. Both the British and French were en route to the Dutch Cape Colony, the former to capture it and the latter to help defend it before proceeding to France's colonies in the Indian Ocean.

zh.s: 普拉亚港之战于1781年4月16日在美国独立战争期间爆发，交战双方是乔治·约翰斯通准将指挥的英国皇家海军舰队和皮埃尔·安德烈·德·叙弗朗率领的法国海军分舰队。英法两支舰队当时都在前往荷兰开普殖民地的途中：英国准备攻占当地，法国则打算协助防守，随后再驶往其在印度洋的殖民地。

en.s: In the Battle of Ceva on 16 April 1796, troops of the First French Republic under Pierre Augereau fought against part of the army of the Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont led by General Giuseppe Felice, Count Vital. Augereau assaulted the strong defensive position without success. At the direction of the Sardinian army commander, Feldmarschal-Leutnant Michelangelo Colli, Vital withdrew on the 17th in order to avoid being trapped by a second French division.

zh.s: 1796年4月16日的切瓦之战中，皮埃尔·奥热罗率领法兰西第一共和国军队，与朱塞佩·费利切·维塔尔伯爵将军指挥的部分撒丁—皮埃蒙特王国军队交战。奥热罗进攻坚固防御阵地，未能成功。为避免遭另一支法军师包围，维塔尔依据撒丁军队总司令米开朗基罗·科利中将的命令，于17日撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Mount Tabor was fought on 16 April 1799 between French forces commanded by Napoleon Bonaparte and Jean-Baptiste Kléber against an Ottoman army under Abdullah Pasha al-Azm, the pasha of Damascus. The battle took place during the siege of Acre of French invasion of Egypt and Syria.

zh.s: 塔博尔山之战于1799年4月16日爆发。拿破仑·波拿巴和让-巴蒂斯特·克莱贝尔指挥的法军，与大马士革帕夏阿卜杜拉·帕夏·阿兹姆率领的奥斯曼军队交战。战斗发生在法国入侵埃及和叙利亚期间的阿克围城战阶段。

en.s: The Battle of Pyhäjoki was fought on 16 April 1808, at Pyhäjoki in Northern Ostrobothnia during the Russian–Swedish war of 1808–09. The winter made the operations more difficult and the battle of Pyhäjoki became one of the first skirmishes to be fought after the Swedish retreat stopped. The Russian army had been following the Swedish army to the north. At the same time, they had left large portions of Finland to be occupied by the Russians. The battle of Pyhäjoki was quite intense, but von Döbeln ordered a retreat in order to follow the original strategic plan, which had been drawn up by Wilhelm Mauritz Klingspor.

zh.s: 皮海约基之战于1808年4月16日在北博滕的皮海约基发生，属于1808年至1809年俄瑞战争。冬季使军事行动更加困难，此战是瑞军停止后撤后最早发生的几场小规模交战之一。此前俄军一直尾随瑞军向北推进，瑞军撤离后，芬兰大片地区落入俄军控制。皮海约基的战斗相当激烈，但冯·德贝伦为遵循威廉·毛里茨·克林斯波尔制定的原有战略计划，下令撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Sacile (also known as the Battle of Fontana Fredda) on 16 April 1809 and its companion Clash at Pordenone on 15 April saw an Austrian army commanded by Archduke John of Austria defeat a Franco-Italian army led by Eugène de Beauharnais and force it to retreat. Sacile proved to be the most notable victory of John's career. The action took place east of the Livenza River near Sacile in modern-day Italy during the War of the Fifth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars. In April 1809, Archduke John quickly invaded Venetia in northeastern Italy.

zh.s: 1809年4月16日的萨奇莱之战又称丰塔纳弗雷达之战，与15日的波代诺内冲突相连。奥地利约翰大公指挥奥军，击败欧仁·德·博阿尔内率领的法国—意大利军队，并迫使其撤退。这是约翰军事生涯中最显著的胜利。战场位于今意大利萨奇莱附近、利文扎河以东，属于拿破仑战争中的第五次反法同盟战争。1809年4月，约翰大公迅速入侵意大利东北部的威尼西亚地区。

en.s: Bussa's rebellion (14–16 April 1816) was the largest slave revolt in Barbadian history. The rebellion takes its name from the African-born slave, Bussa, who led the rebellion. The rebellion, which was eventually defeated by the colonial militia, was the first of three mass slave rebellions in the British West Indies that shook public faith in slavery in the years leading up to the abolition of slavery in the British Empire and emancipation of former slaves.

zh.s: 布萨起义于1816年4月14日至16日发生，是巴巴多斯历史上规模最大的奴隶起义。起义以非洲出生的奴隶布萨命名，由他领导。殖民地民兵最终镇压了起义。这是英属西印度群岛三次大规模奴隶起义中的第一次；这些起义动摇了公众对奴隶制的信心，并推动了大英帝国废奴和解放奴隶。

en.s: The 1817 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 16, 1817. Incumbent Federalist Governor William Jones ran for election to a seventh term but was defeated by Democratic-Republican nominee Nehemiah R. Knight.

en.s: The Rush–Bagot Treaty or Rush–Bagot Disarmament was a treaty between the United States and Great Britain limiting naval armaments on the Great Lakes and Lake Champlain, following the War of 1812. It was ratified by the United States Senate on April 16, 1818, and was confirmed by Canada, following Confederation in 1867. The treaty provided for a large demilitarization of lakes along the international boundary, where many British naval arrangements and forts remained.

zh.s: 《拉什—巴戈特条约》又称《拉什—巴戈特裁军协定》，是美国和英国在1812年战争后签订的一项条约，限制两国在五大湖和尚普兰湖的海军军备。条约于1818年4月16日获美国参议院批准，1867年加拿大联邦成立后也予以确认。条约大幅削减了国际边界湖区的军事力量；当时该地区仍有许多英国海军设施和堡垒。

en.s: The 1823 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was an uncontested election held on April 16, 1823, to elect the governor of Rhode Island. William C. Gibbs, the Democratic-Republican nominee, was the only candidate and so won with 100% of the vote.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1823年4月16日举行无人竞争的州长选举。民主共和党提名人威廉·C.吉布斯是唯一候选人，以100%的得票率获胜。

en.s: The 1828 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was an uncontested election held on April 16, 1828, to elect the governor of Rhode Island. James Fenner, the incumbent governor and Jackson Republican nominee, was the only candidate and so won with 100% of the vote. Jackson Republicans were a faction of the Democratic-Republican Party which favoured Andrew Jackson over John Quincy Adams for president.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1828年4月16日举行无人竞争的州长选举。现任州长、杰克逊共和派提名人詹姆斯·芬纳是唯一候选人，以100%的得票率获胜。杰克逊共和派是民主共和党内的一个派系，在总统人选上支持安德鲁·杰克逊，反对约翰·昆西·亚当斯。

en.s: The Whanganui campaign was a brief round of hostilities in the North Island of New Zealand as indigenous Māori fought British settlers and military forces in 1847. The campaign, which included a siege of the fledgling Whanganui settlement (then named "Petre"), was among the earliest of the 19th century New Zealand Wars that were fought over issues of land and sovereignty.

en.t: The Great Indian Peninsula Railway opens the first passenger rail in India, from Bori Bunder to Thane
en.s: The Great Indian Peninsula Railway (reporting mark GIPR) was a predecessor of the Central Railway (and by extension, the current state-owned Indian Railways), whose headquarters was at the Bori Bunder railway station in Mumbai (later, the Victoria Terminus and presently the Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus). The Great Indian Peninsula Railway Company was incorporated on 1 August 1849 by the Great Indian Peninsula Railway Company Act 1849 (12 & 13 Vict. c. lxxxiii) of the Parliament of the United Kingdom.

zh.t: 印度首列商业客运火车开行
zh.s: 1853年4月16日，大印度半岛铁路公司开行从孟买博里邦德尔至塔那的列车，成为印度首列商业客运火车。该公司是后来中央铁路、进而印度国有铁路的前身，总部位于孟买博里邦德尔车站，即后来的维多利亚终点站、今天的贾特拉帕蒂·希瓦吉终点站。公司依英国议会通过的1849年《大印度半岛铁路公司法》于当年8月1日成立。

en.t: The Wernerian Natural History Society, a former Scottish learned society, is dissolved
en.s: The Wernerian Natural History Society (12 January 1808 – 16 April 1858), commonly abbreviated as the Wernerian Society, was a learned society interested in the broad field of natural history, and saw papers presented on various topics such as mineralogy, plants, insects, and scholarly expeditions. The Society was an offshoot of the Royal Society of Edinburgh, and from its beginnings it was a rather elite organization.

en.s: The Vilna offensive was a campaign of the Polish–Soviet War of 1919–1921. The Polish army launched an offensive on April 16, 1919, to take Vilnius (Polish: Wilno) from the Red Army. After three days of street fighting from April 19–21, the city was captured by Polish forces, causing the Red Army to retreat. During the offensive, the Poles also succeeded in securing the nearby cities of Lida, Pinsk, Navahrudak, and Baranovichi. The Red Army launched a series of counterattacks in late April, all of which ended in failure. The Soviets briefly recaptured the city a year later, in spring 1920, when the Polish army was retreating along the entire front.

en.s: The Battle of the Cigno Convoy (or Belluno Convoy) was a naval engagement between two British destroyers of the Royal Navy and two torpedo boats of the Regia Marina (Italian Royal Navy) south-east of Marettimo island to the west of Sicily, in the early hours of 16 April 1943. The Italian ships were escorting the transport ship Belluno (4,200 gross register tons) to Tunisia; the torpedo boat Tifone, carried aviation fuel.

zh.s: 天鹅座船队之战又称贝卢诺船队之战，于1943年4月16日凌晨在西西里岛以西的马雷蒂莫岛东南海域爆发。交战双方是英国皇家海军两艘驱逐舰与意大利皇家海军两艘鱼雷艇。意大利舰艇当时正在为“贝卢诺”号运输船护航，该船总登记吨位为4200吨；“台风”号鱼雷艇负责运输航空燃油。

Taking place from 1–16 April 1943, Japanese aircraft—primarily from Imperial Japanese Navy units under the command of Admirals Isoroku Yamamoto and Jinichi Kusaka—attacked Allied ships, aircraft, and land installations in the southeast Solomon Islands and New Guinea.

en.t: Albert Hofmann accidentally discovers the hallucinogenic effects of the research drug LSD. He intentionally takes the drug three days later on April 19
en.s: Albert Hofmann (11 January 1906 – 29 April 2008) was a Swiss chemist known for being the first to synthesize, ingest, and learn of the psychedelic effects of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). Hofmann's team also isolated, named and synthesized the principal psychedelic mushroom compounds psilocybin and psilocin. Hofmann discovered the structure of chitin in 1929. He authored more than 100 scientific articles and numerous books, including LSD: Mein Sorgenkind (LSD: My Problem Child).

zh.t: 霍夫曼意外发现LSD的致幻作用；三天后他主动服用该药
zh.s: 阿尔伯特·霍夫曼（1906年1月11日—2008年4月29日）是瑞士化学家，因最早合成、服用麦角酸二乙胺（LSD）并发现其致幻作用而知名。霍夫曼的团队还分离、命名并合成了裸盖菇素和裸盖菇醇——两种主要的致幻蘑菇成分。他于1929年发现几丁质的结构。他发表了100多篇科学论文和多本书，包括《LSD：我的问题孩子》。

After the Vistula–Oder Offensive of January–February 1945, the Red Army had temporarily halted on a line 60 km (37 mi) east of Berlin.

en.s: The Battle of Groningen took place during the penultimate month of World War II in Europe, on 13 to 16 April 1945, in the city of Groningen. The 2nd Canadian Division attacked Groningen (though the whole division was never in combat at any given time), defended by 7,000 German soldiers and Dutch and Belgian SS troops. There were also many Luftwaffe troops manning flak guns in the area.

en.s: The Texas City disaster was an industrial accident that occurred April 16, 1947, in the Port of Texas City. It was the deadliest industrial accident in U.S. history, and one of the largest non-nuclear explosions. Originating with a mid-morning fire on board the French-registered vessel SS Grandcamp (docked in the port), her cargo of approximately 2,300 tons (approximately 2,100 metric tons) of ammonium nitrate detonated, with the initial blast and subsequent chain-reaction of further fires and explosions in other ships and nearby oil-storage facilities killing at least 581 people, including all but one member of the Texas City fire department.

zh.s: 得克萨斯城灾难是1947年4月16日在该市港口发生的工业事故，也是美国历史上死亡人数最多的工业事故和最大规模的非核爆炸之一。上午稍晚，停泊港内的法国籍“格朗康”号货轮起火，船上约2300吨（约2100公吨）硝酸铵随后爆炸。最初的爆炸又引发其他船只及附近储油设施的连锁火灾和爆炸，造成至少581人死亡。得克萨斯城消防部门除一人外，其余人员全部遇难。

en.t: The Organization of European Economic Co-operation is formed
en.s: The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD; French: Organisation de coopération et de développement économiques, OCDE) is an intergovernmental organisation with 38 member countries. It was founded in 1961 to stimulate economic progress and world trade. The OECD is a forum whose member countries describe themselves as committed to democracy and the market economy, providing a platform for collective problem-solving, analysis, and coordination.

en.s: Apollo 16 was the tenth manned mission in the United States Apollo space program, the fifth and penultimate to land on the Moon and the first to land in the lunar highlands. The second of the so-called "J missions," it was crewed by Commander John Young, Lunar Module Pilot Charles Duke and Command Module Pilot Ken Mattingly. Launched from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida at 12:54 PM EST on April 16, 1972, the mission lasted 11 days, 1 hour, and 51 minutes, and concluded at 2:45 PM EST on April 27.

zh.s: 阿波罗16号是美国阿波罗航天计划的第十次载人任务、第五次也是倒数第二次登月任务，并首次在月球高地着陆。它是所谓“J型任务”中的第二次，由指令长约翰·杨、登月舱驾驶员查尔斯·杜克与指令舱驾驶员肯·马丁利执行。任务于1972年4月16日美国东部标准时间12时54分，从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射，持续11天1小时51分钟，于4月27日东部标准时间14时45分结束。

On April 10, 1983, Iran struck Ayn Al-Qaws with the immediate objective of Al-Fakkah Field (east of al-Amarah) to capture the Baghdad-Basra Highway. The operation was fought mostly by Pasdaran forces and was one of the three costly human wave offensives of 1983, the Iranians failed to defeat the Iraqis.

en.s: The fifth Sarawak state election was held between Wednesday, 15 April and Thursday, 16 April 1987 with a nomination date set on Monday, 6 April 1987. This was a snap election following the Ming Court affair. The state assembly was dissolved on 12 March 1987 by Sarawak governor with the advice of chief minister of Sarawak, Abdul Taib Mahmud. All the 48 Sarawak state assembly seats were contested. In this election, Sarawak Barisan Nasional (BN) fielded candidates for all 48 seats, PBDS for 21 seats, PERMAS for 21 seats, Democratic Action Party (DAP) for 11 seats, and Sarawak Democratik Bersatu (BERSATU) for one seat.

zh.s: 第五次砂拉越州选举于1987年4月15日星期三至16日星期四举行，提名日为4月6日星期一。这是在“明阁事件”后提前举行的选举。砂拉越州元首依据首席部长阿卜杜勒·泰益·马哈茂德的建议，于3月12日解散州议会。全部48个席位均有竞争。砂拉越国民阵线派人角逐全部48席，砂拉越达雅党参选21席，砂拉越马来西亚人民团结党参选21席，民主行动党参选11席，砂拉越民主团结党参选1席。

en.s: The Shatoy ambush (known in Russia as the Battle of Yarysh-mardy) was a significant event during the First Chechen War. Chechen insurgents under the leadership of their Arab-born commander, Ibn al-Khattab, would launch an attack on a large Russian Armed Forces army convoy resulting in a three hour long battle.

en.s: The Piedmontese regional election of 2000 took place on 16 April 2000. Enzo Ghigo (Forza Italia) was re-elected for the second time in a row President, defeating Livia Turco (Democrats of the Left). His re-election resulted in a landslide, as this time he was supported also by Lega Nord Piemont. en.s: The Italian regional elections of 2000 were held on 16 April. For the very first time, following the 1999 constitutional reform, the presidents of the Regions were directly elected by citizens. Alongside this change, a new provision was introduced: the President is elected for a five-year term, but if during the term they face a vote of no confidence, resign, or die, under the simul stabunt, simul cadent clause (literally, “they will stand together or they will fall together”), the regional council is also dissolved, and a snap election is called.

zh.s: 意大利于2000年4月16日举行自治区选举。根据1999年宪法改革，各大区主席首次由公民直接选举产生。新规还规定主席任期五年；若任期内遭遇不信任投票、辞职或去世，大区议会也会解散并提前举行选举，这项规则称为“同进同退”（simul stabunt, simul cadent）。

en.s: In April 2001, Bangladesh and India engaged in a series of armed clashes along the international border between the two countries. The clashes took place between troops of the Bangladesh Rifles (BDR) and the Indian Border Security Force (BSF) on the poorly-marked border. The clashes began on 16 April 2001, when a force of around 800 to a 1000 Bangladeshi Paramilitary soldiers attacked and captured Padua/Pyrdiwah village, breaking the status quo and forcing the civilians there to flee.

en.s: The Treaty of Accession 2003 was the agreement between the member states of the European Union and ten countries (Czech Republic, Estonia, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania, Hungary, Malta, Poland, Slovenia, Slovakia), concerning these countries' accession into the EU (see 2004 enlargement of the European Union). At the same time it changed a number of points which were originally laid down in the Treaty of Nice. The treaty was signed on 16 April 2003 in Athens, Greece and it entered into force on 1 May 2004, resulting in enlargement of the European Union with 10 states.

en.s: The tenth Sarawak state election was held on Saturday, 16 April 2011 after nomination for candidates on Wednesday, 6 April 2011. The purpose of the election was to elect 71 representatives to the Sarawak State Assembly. The ninth state assembly was dissolved by Yang di-Pertua Negeri Sarawak, Tun Abang Muhammad Salahuddin Abang Barieng on the advice of Chief Minister Abdul Taib Mahmud on 21 March 2011. The previous state election in Sarawak was held in 2006. The election resulted in Barisan Nasional (BN) retaining its two-thirds majority, albeit by a reduced margin. BN lost eight seats, mainly through the Sarawak United People's Party (SUPP).

zh.s: 第十次砂拉越州选举于2011年4月16日星期六举行，候选人提名日为4月6日星期三，选出州议会71名议员。州元首敦阿邦·穆罕默德·萨拉胡丁·阿邦·巴林，依据首席部长阿卜杜勒·泰益·马哈茂德的建议，于3月21日解散第九届州议会。上一次州选于2006年举行。国民阵线保住三分之二多数席位，但优势缩小，共失去八席，主要由砂拉越人民联合党丢失。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Nigeria on 16 April 2011, postponed from 9 April 2011. The election followed controversy as to whether a northerner or southerner should be allowed to become president given the tradition of rotating the top office between the north and the south after the death of Umaru Yar'Adua, a northerner, when Goodluck Jonathan, another southerner assumed the interim presidency. Immediately after the election widespread violence erupted in the northern, Muslim parts of the country. Jonathan was declared the winner on 19 April.

zh.s: 尼日利亚总统选举原定于2011年4月9日举行，后推迟至4月16日。此前，来自北方的总统乌马鲁·亚拉杜瓦去世，南方出身的古德勒克·乔纳森接任临时总统，因而引发争议：按照最高职位由南北轮流担任的惯例，这次应由北方人还是南方人参选总统。投票刚结束，北部穆斯林地区便爆发广泛暴力事件。4月19日，乔纳森被宣布为获胜者。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Timor-Leste on 17 March and 16 April 2012 to choose a president for a five-year term. Incumbent president Jose Ramos-Horta, who was eligible for a second and final term as president, announced that he would seek nomination to be a candidate in the election. The election was seen as a test for the "young democracy" in seeking to take control of its own security. Former military commander Taur Matan Ruak provisionally beat Francisco Guterres in a second round runoff.

zh.s: 东帝汶于2012年3月17日与4月16日举行总统选举，选出任期五年的总统。现任总统若泽·拉莫斯·奥尔塔有资格争取第二个、也是最后一个任期，并宣布寻求提名参选。东帝汶希望自行负责国家安全，此次选举被视为对这个“年轻民主国家”的考验。第二轮决选的初步结果显示，前军队司令陶尔·马坦·鲁阿克击败弗朗西斯科·古特雷斯。

en.s: The 2012 Pulitzer Prizes were awarded on April 16, 2012, by the Pulitzer Prize Board for work during the 2011 calendar year. The deadline for submitting entries was January 25, 2012. For the first time, all entries for journalism were required to be submitted electronically. In addition, the criteria for the Pulitzer Prize for Local Reporting has been revised to focus on real-time reporting of breaking news.

en.s: The Baga massacre began on 16 April 2013 in the village of Baga, Nigeria, in Borno State, when as many as 200 civilians were killed, hundreds wounded, and over 2,000 houses and businesses worth millions of Naira were destroyed. Refugees, civilians officials, and human rights organizations accused the Nigerian Military of carrying out the massacre; some military officials blamed the insurgent group Boko Haram.

en.s: The sinking of MV Sewol (Hangul: 세월호 침몰 사고; hanja: 世越號沉沒事故) occurred on the morning of 16 April 2014, en route from Incheon to Jeju in South Korea. The ferry capsized while carrying 476 people, mostly secondary school students from Danwon High School (Ansan City). The 6,825-ton vessel sent a distress signal from about 2.7 kilometres (1.7 mi) north off Byeongpungdo at 08:58 Korea Standard Time (23:58 UTC, 15 April 2014). In all, 304 passengers and crew members died in the disaster. Of the approximately 172 survivors, more than half were rescued by fishing boats and other commercial vessels that arrived at the scene approximately 40 minutes after the South Korean coast guard.

zh.s: 2014年4月16日上午，韩国渡轮“世越”号从仁川驶往济州途中倾覆。船上载有476人，大多数为安山市檀园高中的中学生。这艘6825吨的渡轮于韩国标准时间8时58分（协调世界时4月15日23时58分），在屏风岛以北约2.7公里（1.7英里）处发出求救信号。事故共造成304名乘客与船员死亡。约172名幸存者中，超过一半由渔船和其他商船救起；这些船只在韩国海警抵达约40分钟后到达现场。

en.s: General elections were held in Sudan on 13–16 April 2015 to elect the President and the National Assembly. They were originally scheduled for 2 April, but were delayed by eleven days. These were the first elections to be held following the secession of South Sudan. Incumbent President Omar al-Bashir won the presidential election by a landslide, amid a boycott from the majority of the opposition.

en.t: Ecuador's worst earthquake in nearly 40 years kills 676 and injures more than 230,000
en.s: The 2016 Ecuador earthquake occurred on April 16 at 18:58:37 ECT with a moment magnitude of 7.8 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of VIII (Severe). The very large thrust earthquake was centered approximately 27 km (17 mi) from the towns of Muisne and Pedernales in a sparsely populated part of the country, and 170 km (110 mi) from the capital Quito, where it was felt strongly.
